title: Book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='cover' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#c0392b'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#8e2419'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- open book, pages fanned -->
  <g transform='translate(0,8)'>
    <!-- left page stack -->
    <path d='M12 30 Q30 24 48 30 L48 80 Q30 74 12 80 Z' fill='#f4ead6'/>
    <path d='M16 33 Q31 28 45 33 L45 77 Q31 72 16 77 Z' fill='#fffaf0'/>
    <!-- right page stack -->
    <path d='M52 30 Q70 24 88 30 L88 80 Q70 74 52 80 Z' fill='#f4ead6'/>
    <path d='M55 33 Q69 28 84 33 L84 77 Q69 72 55 77 Z' fill='#fffaf0'/>
    <!-- spine shadow -->
    <path d='M48 30 L52 30 L52 80 L48 80 Z' fill='#e0cba8'/>
    <!-- cover edges -->
    <path d='M9 28 Q30 21 48 28 L48 82 Q30 75 9 82 Z' fill='none' stroke='#8e2419' stroke-width='3'/>
    <path d='M52 28 Q70 21 91 28 L91 82 Q70 75 52 82 Z' fill='none' stroke='#8e2419' stroke-width='3'/>
    <!-- text lines on pages -->
    <g stroke='#d9c3a0' stroke-width='2.2' stroke-linecap='round'>
      <line x1='20' y1='42' x2='42' y2='39'/>
      <line x1='20' y1='49' x2='42' y2='46'/>
      <line x1='20' y1='56' x2='42' y2='53'/>
      <line x1='20' y1='63' x2='38' y2='60.5'/>
      <line x1='58' y1='39' x2='80' y2='42'/>
      <line x1='58' y1='46' x2='80' y2='49'/>
      <line x1='58' y1='53' x2='80' y2='56'/>
      <line x1='58' y1='60.5' x2='76' y2='63'/>
    </g>
    <!-- ribbon bookmark -->
    <path d='M50 12 L50 30 L46 26 L50 22 L54 26 Z' fill='#f1c40f'/>
    <rect x='48.5' y='6' width='4' height='26' fill='#f1c40f'/>
  </g>
</svg>
